frame.pixel_rule: flat px (x, y) -> node ((x + 0.5)/20, (y + 0.5)/20); 1 px = 1 level-0 voxel
frame.orientation: raw (flat-map) frame; reading display = flip lr + ud

value: uint8, 255 = Reader v3 ink probability 1; *_blind = reversed layer order (control)
depth: d = window centre offset in voxels along the surface normal (positive = outward, away from the scroll axis)
depthpair: per pixel max over d of mean(m_d, m_d+1), d=-4..+2; m_d averaged over 8 flips/transposes at d=-2,0,+1 (code/depthpair.py)
